BlackRock MuniAssets Fund Price Performance NYSE MUA traded down $0.04 on Thursday, hitting $9.50. The stock had a trading volume of 616,633 shares, compared to its average volume of 370,804. The company's 50-day moving average is $10.06 and its two-hundred day moving average is $10.48. BlackRock MuniAssets Fund has a one year low of $9.43 and a one year high of $11.34. BlackRock MuniAssets Fund Announces Dividend The firm also recently disclosed a monthly dividend, which will be paid on Tuesday, December 22nd. Investors of record on Friday, December 11th will be issued a $0.0555 dividend. This represents a $0.67 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 7.0%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, December 11th. BlackRock MuniAssets Fund Company Profile ( Get Free Report ) BlackRock MuniAssets Fund, Inc NYSE: MUA is a closed-end management investment company managed by BlackRock Advisors, LLC. The fund seeks to provide investors with current income that is exempt from regular federal income tax by investing primarily in municipal bonds and other tax-exempt municipal obligations.
